name: 材料カードの含有食品の案内を確認する
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Correct ONE Japanese Lighthouse Caesar ingredient card LH19-0004.
Image1 ORIGINAL source sweetgreen card is HIGHEST detail authority. Image2 exact ORIGINAL dressing photo crop, protected artwork; retain this image's actual bowl shape, its small speckles, lighting, beige background and original soft shadow. Do not invent a new bowl/photo. Image3 Japanese mock secondary text guide. Image4 generated v001 is correction target.
TWO corrections: (1) 「シーザー」 MUST be light/Regular Meiryo, NEVER bold or display heading. At logical scale label14px/24 Regular and red warning12px/16 Regular, tracking0. Match the original's regular card-label weight; v001 heavy label is wrong. (2) Keep ORIGINAL photo content/crop rather than the reimagined v001 photograph.
Single narrow white rounded card on pure white canvas. Top centered regular 「シーザー」, original photo middle, bottom red #B63F32 「魚を含みます」. Preserve red because actual contains-fish semantic warning. No CTA, extra icon, extra claims, new food, selection state, heading, brand orb or surrounding UI. Fine neutral border and extremely gentle downward shadow; modest compact spacing and full text visibility. All other details unchanged. Output only the corrected component image.
reviewNotes: 2回目を実見。ラベルをRegularへ改善、赤い魚含有警告と日本語を維持。写真は依然再描画で原本の器／質感の厳密保持を満たさない。限定2試行で未受入のまま保持して他項目へ続行。所有者承認・実食品保証・ネイティブ編集・アプリ動作は未認定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
